items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: They brought Mose Farrer up to play in Brown's band which I didn't know.

ctx.x: Of course it's a funny business a publishing business.

Oh here's what I started to tell you my train of thought. Mose Farrer F-E-R-R-E-R Farrer played piano with the Owls. When that piano player went up with them on a low account had a fallen out with Brown's band. They brought Mose Farrer up to play in Brown's band which I didn't know. It was a very short while but he did play with them in Chicago for about a month or six weeks. Mose was a pianist, his brother was a violinist and his mother was a professional music teacher. They lived sometime somewhere up around…
Well I think of it do you have any information on Arnold Licano? Last time I saw Papa Lane it's been three or four months now maybe. He said that Arnold Licano was so sick.
